trap.label: take issue with
trap.wrong: He took issue to the report’s method.
trap.right: He took issue with the report’s method.
trap.why: Em português “discordar de” sugere preposição vaga. Em inglês, take issue with e take exception to.

fix.wrong: She took on math at twelve and took to it.
fix.right: She took up math at twelve and took to it.

fix.wrong: He took exception with the tone.
fix.right: He took exception to the tone.

fix.wrong: A private tutor taken issue with the notes.
fix.right: A private tutor took issue with the notes.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com take up: “She began studying math.”
Reescreva com take issue with: “He disagrees with the method.”
rewrite.answer: He takes issue with the method.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com take exception to: “He was offended by the tone.”
rewrite.answer: He took exception to the tone.
